name: Documesh
description: Federated developer documentation search across 47 vendors. Search, error matching, and vendor lookup with version-cited, license-attributed results. Powered by WebMCP.

skills.name: Federated Documentation Search
skills.description: Search developer documentation across 47 vendors (Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, Kubernetes, React, PyTorch, Stripe, Sentry, and more) simultaneously. Every result carries vendor, version, license, and canonical source URL.

skills.name: Error to Docs Matching
skills.description: Match an error message or stack trace to the closest official documentation sections, with an honest disclaimer — never a fake diagnosis.

skills.name: Source License Lookup
skills.description: Look up license and attribution information for every documentation source in the mesh.
examples: what license is the Cloudflare docs under?

skills.name: Config Verification
skills.description: Diff a user's configuration file against the keys a source documents. Returns missing keys (each cited to the docs) and unknown keys (possible typos). Heuristic, honest about limits.
examples: check my wrangler.toml against Cloudflare docs

skills.name: Cross-Source Config Mapping
skills.description: Compare documented configuration keys between two sources (e.g. Netlify vs Vercel redirects) — common keys matched by name/concepts, gaps listed explicitly.
examples: map heroku config vars to cloudflare workers vars

skills.name: Provider Health Probe
skills.description: Probe a provider's public status page (Cloudflare, GitHub, npm, Sentry) to answer 'is it down or is it me?' after an error.

skills.name: Mesh Contribution
skills.description: Submit a documentation source for ingestion, report outdated or incorrect chunks, and view contribution stats. All writes are queued proposals — nothing mutates the mesh directly.
examples: report this doc section as outdated
